content: {"id":"f5ebe27b-58bd-417e-9b42-d46d46ba934d","type":"https://serlo.org/editor","variant":"serlo-org","domainOrigin":"serlo.org","version":2,"editorVersion":"0.22.0","dateModified":"2025-02-26T18:27:05.804Z","document":{"plugin":"exercise","state":{"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Setze drei verschiedene Faktoren so ein, dass sich das Produkt "},{"type":"math","src":"66\\ ","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":"ergibt.  \\1p."}]}],"id":"ce6a184a-9e35-4b5c-93e5-16c79c803b37"},{"plugin":"image","state":{"src":"https://assets.serlo.org/3493e7a0-9862-11ef-9b62-81d9fbac88ac/image.png","caption":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""}]}],"id":"6c93b64b-1647-4133-b9e3-9ab99f6b7868"}},"id":"1e52f4a0-5f17-4b38-9622-11b7b820d681"}],"id":"3015b97c-00ae-4cd0-a5ee-2f6a20845ecf"},"solution":{"plugin":"solution","state":{"strategy":{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""}]}],"id":"a4a1c3d7-b69b-441b-b45c-762edf6f8eff"},"steps":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Anstatt auszuprobieren, ist es hier am einfachsten, drei Teiler von "},{"type":"math","src":"66","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":" zu finden."}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Dafür teilt man zuerst "},{"type":"math","src":"66","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":" durch seinen kleinsten Teiler (nach "},{"type":"math","src":"1","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":"), nämlich "},{"type":"math","src":"2","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":":"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""},{"type":"math","src":"66 : 2 = 33","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":""}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Damit hat man schon einen Faktor gefunden. Da "},{"type":"math","src":"33","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":" nicht durch "},{"type":"math","src":"2","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":" teilbar ist, teilt man als nächstes durch "},{"type":"math","src":"3","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":":"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""},{"type":"math","src":"33 : 3 = 11","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":" "}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Schon hat man drei Faktoren gefunden, die zusammen multipliziert "},{"type":"math","src":"66","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":" ergeben:"}]},{"type":"p","children":[{"text":""},{"type":"math","src":"2 \\cdot 3 \\cdot 11 = 66","inline":true,"children":[{"text":""}]},{"text":""}]}],"id":"b9087919-c209-4b01-bb18-17dbc434959a"}],"id":"28f378f4-9e2f-469e-b6a4-08c21e2ab94a"},"prerequisite":{"id":"148192","title":"Ganze Zahlen multiplizieren und dividieren"}},"id":"b2fa5659-24f6-42a2-9cf4-7eb9469dffd0"}},"id":"7a4c384f-5bf6-411d-8c84-54cb0487c55b"}}
